mentions.note: 2nd Surrey League race 2 and race 4; won Surrey League individual title

photos.c: Matt Hillier and Robert Xerri of Hercules Wimbledon slug it out at Surrey League Race 4. Matt won to keep Belgrave's 100% record of individual victories but none of our high placers competed in every match, leaving the way clear for the Hercules Wimbledon lad to pick up the individual title.
